balls.text: Full-toss, and Tare hits it over the leg side. He seems to hit that well, but Faf pops up out of nowhere to take what was in the end a pretty simple catch.
short, wide, slapped down the ground, and it hit Tare in the midriff at the non-striker's end. He somehow completed the run, before collapsing in a heap at the batting crease.

full toss, waist-high, swatted over the leg side. Jadeja sprints to his left, catches it, but it seems to stick in his hands as he runs over the ropes. He tried to throw it back but didn't manage to, and signals six even before the umpire does.
Angled across Corey, who hits it over cover's head, but a wide long-off is there to cut it off. Dhoni had moved that fielder there just before this ball.
oh dear. That's way outside the wide line outside off. Almost hits the return crease.
Hit hard down the ground by Corey, straight at the bowler. Pandey gets a hand to it and slows it down to deflect it towards long-on.
Full, angling in towards off stump. Corey gives himself room, hits it down to long-off.
Slower ball, takes an age to get to Tare, who gives himself room, gets down on his knee, and cuts it to point.
short, wide, slapped. Deep cover runs to his left but has no chance of cutting it off.
Short, on off, just goes over off stump, in fact, as Tare tries to pull and misses.
short, not that wide, but Tare chops down on it and finds the gap to the right of third man.

Slower ball, big step back and across, and out comes the slog. Doesn't time it at all and the ball drops into Jadeja's hands. He barely had to move at deep midwicket. The batsmen didn't even cross, which means Anderson won't be on strike next ball.

whatay catch! slow carrom ball, and Pollard's top hand comes off as he slogs at it. Connects fairly well, and Raina, running to his right, takes it the Australian way, hands pointing up, but it nearly pops out. He somehow keeps it in his grasp as he falls to the floor.
length ball, swept square.
Down the pitch, clean swing of his arms and it goes soaring over long-on.
gone! Raina takes a good catch running to his left as Rohit tries to slog the carrom ball. It was high over his shoulder, but Raina took it with both hands before going on a tumble with the momentum.
Legbreak, it looked like. swept away behind square.
down the track, full ball outside off, squeezed down to short third man.

What a stop! full, outside off, launched to the left of long-on, and Faf leaps to his left, puts his hands together, and pushes it back into play even as he dives over the rope. That, for all you football fans swarming here, could have been Peter Schmeichel at his best.
slower ball, tucked away behind square. Two looked on, but the batsmen decided against it as Jadeja swooped down over the ball.
Rohit comes down the track, Mohit bowls it into the blockhole, and the batsman jams his bat down on it to steer it towards point.
predictably, a short ball. Rayudu moves across, inside the line, and swats it away to long leg.
down the track, low full-toss outside off, hit straight to deep cover.
back of a length, Rayudu goes deep in his crease and muscles it wide of long on.
shorter, Rohit slaps it away to deep cover.
round-arm from Jadeja, towards middle stump. Defended off the front foot.
down the pitch once more, driven wide of long-off.
down the track again, Jadeja pushes it through. Rayudu drives to deep cover.
big swing of those arms, and the ball disappears over long-on. He had used his feet well to that.
Bit of turn, and Rohit gets a thick edge to short third man as he tries to push it towards the on side.
Rayudu gives himself room, slashes, and misses.
slower ball, outside off. Rohit opens the face of his bat, lets it run down to third man.
short, on off stump. Rohit goes on his toes and punches it to cover.

shortish, just outside off. Rohit opens the face of his bat, and that's terrible fielding from Pandey on the boundary. Didn't bend down quick enough, and it scrapes his fingertips before sliding over the rope.
slower ball, Rohit waits and twirls his wrists to find midwicket.
gives himself room to steer it to the right of third man.
slogged away to deep midwicket from way outside off, Raina does the fielding again.
short, pulled, Raina runs to his right from deep midwicket to stop it with a dive.
tossed up, outside off, driven to long-off.
played late, with a turn of the wrist, behind square leg. They decide against the single.

turn and bounce again, Rohit takes his bottom hand off as he tries to cut. He's a little slow taking off, and Dwayne Smith throws hard from cover. Misses the stumps, and Suresh Raina has to make a diving stop on the leg-side boundary as they run overthrows.
Rayudu is back in his crease to work this away towards midwicket.
pushed into the leg side for a walked single.
skids on, flicked to deep square leg.
quick, bit of bounce, hits Rohit high on the bat as he tries to defend.
flat, outside off, driven to deep extra cover.

Shortish ball, tennis-forehanded and hit very hard past Badree, who doesn't really make an effort to stop the ball. Faf does, diving to his right after running hard from long-off, but he's hit the rope with his elbow as he pushed the ball back in.
skids on towards the pads, worked away towards square leg.
Slow, on middle-and-leg, Rohit works a single behind square.
he's gone. clears his front leg, swings hard, but can only hit it down long-on's throat.
Tossed up. Down the pitch, driven hard down the ground. Faf ran to his left from long on and made a diving stop.
not too much turn this time. Cut to the sweeper.
pushed down to long-on.
Carrom ball. Gives himself width, gets a thick outside edge that runs away fine to the third man boundary, beats a despairing dive from Badree.
round-arm once more, and the batsman is back in his crease to defend into the off side.
Extremely round-arm from Jadeja, slapped to deep cover.
slashed over cover, straight to the sweeper.
down the track, chipped to long-off.
goes down on one knee, opens up his body, and slog-sweeps powerfully over deep midwicket.

dropped again! Manhas this time, at deep cover. Jadeja saw Rayudu come down the track, bowled it wider. He went through with the big shot anyway. Manhas ran forward, and had it in his grasp, but it popped out.
Turn once more. Simmons gives himself room but he can only hit it straight back to Ashwin.
turn again, and Simmons inside-edges it onto his pads as he tries to cut.
shortish, pulled to deep midwicket.
big turn, from outside off. Rayudu is forced to change his mind and defend towards the off side instead of cut.
offbreak, outside off. Rayudu defends towards the leg side.
gives himself room, tries to smack it through the off side. Can only hit it straight to cover.
down the track again, no turn, hurries on and hits Simmons on the front pad.
full, just outside off, driven down to long-off.
gives himself room, Jadeja follows him. Forced to nurdle it into the leg side.
down the track, doesn't time it as he tries to heave across the line. Deep midwicket picks it up on the boundary.
bit of turn, checked drive with an open face to the off-side sweeper.
shortish, outside off, seams in a bit. Simmons is on the hop as he pushes it to point.
slower ball, Simmons is down the track but isn't in position for an aggressive shot. Defensive push to cover.
fullish ball outside off, beats Simmons as he tries a forcing drive.
comes forward and pushes it to point, where Jadeja pounces on the ball and throws hard at the bowler's end. Might have been close if he hit. Yup. Rayudu would have been out.
full and wide, driven to the left of the off-side sweeper.
Shortish, slightly wide of off, cut away into the ground, bounces over the point fielder.
defended watchfully off the front foot, down the pitch.
pushed into the off side.
sliced towards short third man.
comes forward, looks to push into the off side and run, decides against it.
width, and Simmons punishes it, going deep in his crease to cut.
bit of turn outside off. Beaten as he tries to push it into the off side.
bit of width, cut straight to point.
sashays down the pitch, but he's in no position as the ball straightens, bounces and beats him all ends up.

Dropped! Down the track again, and he's looking to go over cover, but the ball slices off the outside half thanks to the swing. and goes towards Badree at third man. It was a simple catch, but he let it bounce off his fingers as he jumped.
shortish, outswing. Rayudu pokes and misses. He was trying to run it to third man.
sees Rayudu walking down the pitch, bowls it wide. Rayudu hits smoothly through the line and over mid-off.
pushed wide of mid-off, quick single.
slides towards the pads, worked away wide of long-on, where Faf du Plessis dives and throws in one motion.
down the track, and Simmons hits this cleanly, swinging freely through the line to send it soaring over long-on.
quicker, flatter, pushed towards cover.
tossed it up a bit, and Simmons swings through the line. Bounces right on top of the long-off rope.
Slow, short, wide. Simmons gives himself even more room, and finds he isn't close enough to connect cleanly, hits straight to cover.
away-swing again, and Rayudu is beaten as he pokes at it from the crease.
shortish, swing, bounces before it reaches Dhoni as Rayudu slashes and misses.
shorter, rises up to Rayudu's chest. He stays beside the line and tries to cut. Finds the point fielder.
This one doesn't swing, and Rayudu waits before bunting it into the off side. Decides against taking a single.
Rayudu shoulders arms again. Pandey's not wavered much from that line.
same channel, slightly fuller, bit of outswing again, and Rayudu lets it go. Called wide. Close.
Another ball in that outside-off channel. Simmons steers it away to third man.
skids on from just outside off, towards off-and-middle. Rayudu comes forward and defends with soft hands.
and he's gone! It was too far outside off for him to control the sweep. Gautam goes for it anyway, and it loops up, off the outside edge, straight to McCullum at square leg.
legbreak, bit of turn from middle-and-leg, defended watchfully.
Down the track, and it's only a little push, but it screams away for four just behind point.
length ball, outside off. Tries to sweep but doesn't middle it. Fielded at midwicket.
not that short, and no turn, Gautam goes back to cut, gets a thick edge just wide of the keeper's gloves.
shortish again, outside off again, and Simmons opens his face but finds the point fielder.
outswing again, from a back of a length ball outside off. left alone.
short, sits up, and Simmons pulls it with a little flick in his follow-through.
shortish, outside off, pushed to point.
shorter this time, but movement again. Simmons withdraws his bat at the last moment.
wide outside off, bit of outswing, Simmons lets it go.
angled into the pads, worked into the leg side.
shortish ball, not much turn. Gautam goes back to push it down the ground.
length ball, straight. Defended off the front foot.
back of a length on off, straightens. Defended back to the bowler.
full, on the stumps, checked drive down to long-on.
shortish, outside off, pushed to point.
first ball this season, slips down the leg side. Dhoni can't quite gather it.

short, wide, slapped away in typical Dhoni fashion. The off-side fielders had come into the circle with just two needed, and this went just wide of Harbhajan at extra cover. Rohit Sharma kicks out in frustration.
slower ball, length ball, outside off. Dhoni swings hard across the line, and it goes flat but still clears deep midwicket comfortably.
wide again, Dhoni cuts it, Anderson runs to his right from deep point, has to run around it to throw with his left arm. Dhoni makes his ground as he sprints back for the second.
baaaad ball to start with. Tries to aim for the tramlines, and gets it horribly wrong. It's short and waaay outside off.

he's gone! inswinging yorker, inside-edged to fine leg. They take on PK's arm, and it isn't the best throw, on the bounce to Gautam, but he still manages to get the bails off before Manhas can slide in. It's in the air, moreover, as it crosses the crease. Third umpire takes a long time, but finally gives it out.
got him! widish yorker, and Jadeja inside-edges it onto his stumps as he tries to chop down on it and take a single into the off side.
Full and straight, Dhoni uses his wrists to hit it straight back but Malinga gets his right boot across to make a good stop.
slower ball, full, outside off. Steered away to deep cover.
Low full-toss, outside off, and Jadeja pushes it to deep point.
low full-toss, poked down to long-on.
tries to come forward and play the square drive, hits it straight to backward point.
low full toss outside off, steered towards deep point.
short, big angle from wide of the crease, and Dhoni smartly walks across and gets a wide down the leg side.
slower ball, short, chopped down to long-off.
Short ball, dropped down towards midwicket.
Short, sits up, pulled past midwicket.
angled in, and Dhoni knocks it down to long-on.
short ball, defended towards square leg, direct hit at the keeper's end, but no overthrows.

whoa, there. slower ball, drops on a full length, turns like an offcutter and hits Jadeja low on the pad. Big appeal, not given. Runs away down to third man, where Praveen fumbles. That looked to be hitting the stumps.
what a ball! slower ball, right up in the blockhole. It hits the base of the stumps, in fact, after dipping under Faf's flailing bat. It seemed to hang in the air before dipping at the last moment.
full and wide, Dhoni plays a checked drive in front of cover.
slower ball, forced in front of point off the back foot.
short, angled in towards off stump. Dhoni cuts it to deep point.
starts off with a short ball that slides down the leg side
Angled down the leg side, hits Dhoni on the pad as he misses the flick.
slower ball, Faf waits an age before pulling it to deep square leg.
full toss, with a bit of late away-swing, and Faf gets a thick edge past the keeper as he slashes hard at it.
same shot, different result. Doesn't get as much behind it this time, and it drops to Simmons, who juggles it and takes it on the third attempt.

Length ball, and Smith moves back and across to allow the big swing across the line. Harbhajan at deep midwicket leaps high in the air, but can't get more than a fingertip on it as it swings away from him.
Full, outside off. Faf walks across and flicks it to deep backward square leg.
length ball, well outside off, and Smith somehow swats it across, with a lot of bottom hand, to find the gap to the left of deep square leg. Top shot.
full toss, hammered down the ground,  Bumrah does well to reverse the momentum of his follow-through and stop that.
slower ball again, and Smith goes across his stumps and beats short fine leg with a leg glance. Deep square leg comes around to make a diving stop.
Slower ball, shortish, Smith goes hard at it but can only hit it straight to cover.
Shortish, angled in, no room to do anything but pull it down to long-on.
Slower ball, and Smith doesn't quite hit it cleanly, which is a good thing since it drops well short of long-on.
straight, back of a length, tucked into the leg side.
fuller this time, and Faf launches it high and straight. Drops just beyond the sightscreen.
this was definitely a slower ball, and Smith swings and misses once more. Rolls down to Gautam, whose fumble allows them to sneak a bye.
was that a slower ball? Maybe. Just misses off stump as Smith swings and misses.
short, wide, hit over the off side and bounces to deep cover.
full, wide, driven to the off-side sweeper.
he only had to connect once for this to become a decent over, and he does. Slog swept way over deep midwicket.
he tries to reverse-sweep this time, and misses again. The ball hits him on the flap of the pad.
tries to sweep from outside off, misses, is hit on the midriff.
turn, bounce, and it hits Smith on his thigh as he tries to pull.
back in his crease to tuck it behind square on the leg side.
tossed up, bit of bounce as Faf comes down the track, is hit on the gloves and it drops down in front of him.
wide, full, driven hard and fielded well by Harbhajan at cover.
full, in the blockhole, pushed down to long-on.
searches for the yorker, and it's a low full-toss that he flicks to midwicket.
Slower ball, tucked into the leg side off the back foot.
full, almost a yorker, tailed in a bit, and Smith falls away a touch as he flicks to midwicket.
shortish slower ball outside off, cut away to deep point.
tossed up, not too much turn. Smith goes deep in his crease to defend.
worked away in front of the backward square leg fielder
short, and Faf gives himself some room and slaps it in front of point.
swept high in the air, but drops short of deep square leg.
tries to sweep, gets hit high on the pad.
back of a length, flat, defended.
in his slot, and Smith takes a step forward and launches it over the bowler's head and way back beyond the straight boundary. Poor ball from Pollard, gave the batsman a lot of room to swing his arms.
swats it behind square on the leg side. Ball turned in his hands a little bit, but it still went away in a hurry.
Ashwin-style legcutter outside leg stump. Smith swipes and misses. Ball misses leg stump, not called wide.
width, and a lot of angle to work with. Smith comes forward to this half-volley and drives it confidently in front of cover.
angled in, worked towards midwicket.
leg-cutter, on off, comes forward and pushes it to point.
comes forward, defends carefully.
goes back and works it away behind square leg.
back of a length, stopped on Faf, and pops up but just short of Pollard at midwicket.
swept, misfield at short fine leg from Bumrah.
wide outside off, tossed, up, Faf goes across, and scoops it over his own head.
hit on the pad as he tries to sweep, loops over the keeper's head.
Wide outside off stump, but just inside the tramlines, as Faf lets it go.

he's gone, is he? Fires it down the leg side as he sees Raina stepping down the pitch. Gautam collects brilliantly down the leg side and has the bails off in a flash. Raina turned around just as quick, though, and he's got his bat in, is it? Or is it in the air when the bails come off? It's hard to tell for sure, but the third umpire seems to think there is. OUT, flashes the big screen. Brave decision, that.
Down the pitch, doesn't get anywhere near the pitch, but how does that matter when you connect so well? Hit cleanly over cover, and rolls away over the unoccupied boundary.
Swipe across the line to deep midwicket off a length ball.
Shortish, widish, slowish, and Smith swats across the line to deep midwicket.
Slower-ish ball outside off, chopped towards point.
superb placement. Waits on the shortish ball, opens his bat face, and hits it to the left of short third man.
Wide, way down the leg side. Raina swings and misses.
turn again, and Raina opens his face and pushes it towards deep point.
Goes with the angle, Smith goes back and bunts it into the leg side.
Short, lots of turn. Raina has to reach for it and cut it down to the sweeper.
Inside-edges the sweep onto the front pad this time, goes down towards short fine leg.
tossed up, bit of bounce, hits him on the midriff as he tries to sweep.
Reverse sweep towards point.
Another short ball, and Raina isn't fully in control with his pull. Gets more bat on it this time, though, and Wankhede runs across to his right and stops it at the boundary.
yorker again, angled across Raina, and he plonks his bat down to hit it towards mid-on.
shortish ball, and it's whipped away, with his front leg coming off the ground, towards deep square leg.
Speared into the blockhole with that angle. Smith does well to jam his bat down on it.
Hits Smith on the thigh as he looks to work it into the leg side.
put down! Short, angled across Raina, and he top-edges his pull. It hangs in the air long enough for Apoorv Wankhede to dive forward, get both hands under the ball... and drop it.
Angled across Raina again, and he pushes it down to mid-off.
Swings, but starts from way outside leg stump, and Raina puts it away with a flick of his wrists.
Angled across towards off stump. Raina defends watchfully.
Given! McCullum is hit on the front pad as he tries to pull. That definitely looked like it was going down the leg side. You could see both middle and off stump on the replay, from straight-on.
Tries another cut. Hits it to wide mid-off.
Inswing. McCullum gives himself room, but can't make enough to get anything behind the cut.
Tries to drive it through the off side, but it goes off the inside half of his bat down towards mid-on.
Width, and McCullum's punished that, carving it past point off the back foot.
Two steps down the pitch and a big swing of his arms. Goes high over the long-on boundary.
Hit on the pad once more as he tries to whip it away to the leg side. More leg byes. Bumrah will never get an lbw with that angle.
Big angle in from wide of the crease. Smith is cramped for room, drops it into the leg side.
Angled down the leg side, McCullum is hit on the front pad as he tries to flick.
Inswinging yorker, McCullum gets his front foot out of the way and drives wristily to long on.
shuffles across this time, and plays it with the swing, into the leg side.
Another inswinger, another swipe, another miss.
huuuuge inswing there. This is PK at his best. The ball goes over off stump as he pulls and misses.
Shortish ball, comes back in off the pitch. Tries to cut, misses.
Bit of away swing outside off, swipes across the line, misses.
full and swung away late towards off stump, batsman gets his bat down in time, jams the ball away towards mid-on for a single
slower one, 116.4kph, short of length and on  off, defended towards midwicket
beaten outside off, full swinging delivery once more, Smith looking to drive through the off and can't get bat on it as the ball curves away
short of length ball on legstump, clipped towards square leg
full ball outside off, swinging away, lashed towards cover where Anderson makes a diving stop
starts with a slow delivery, 113.4 kph, on the pads, tucked towards midwicket
moving away outside off, guided towards third man for four more, Praveen getting good shape here, but he's being taken for runs as well
pushed to the off side this time, no run

superb cricket this time, Praveen starts it off with an off stump delivery that is a carved away towards deep point, seemed to be headed to the boundary, but a sprinting Pollard gets his boot in the way to prevent the ball from reaching the rope
Praveen getting the ball to curl away, but that doesn't deter Smith, who steps forward and launches that over extra cover for four
short of length ball outside off, a seriously ugly swipe from Smith, good contact and the ball races towards deep midwicket
starts with a length ball that moves away, right on off stump, defended to the off side
